name: NumberGrid-74x74-wild_mountains
battle_recovery: Living units regenerate by native unit + lord + either fort or own-land bonus, rounded up once. City/capital recovery and recruitment require ownership; paid healing/revival still require the capital temple. Victory preserves wounds. Entry with a living hero captures cities only after both defenders are defeated.
battle_engagement: A directional command targeting a living enemy stack starts combat from the current tile. Original zone of control: a step onto a tile beside a living stack outside a city, capital or ruin stops there and starts combat with it; a hero already beside such a stack attacks it instead of stepping to another tile beside it; entering a city or the capital is exempt. Entry costs ceil(half the full movement allowance), capped at remaining points; only a step into a zone also pays that step, under the same cap; zero points forbids attack. Victory and retreat keep the attacker on the tile it fought from. Chests open only after a step that starts no combat.
reconstruction_note: S143 with the Legions-side scripted events, without thieves; armies walk the shortest path to capitals and cities; agent-controlled garrison defense; original victory: hold Shornhelm, destroy Sir Allemon and Gumtik.
